assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The symptoms raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia
The CPT code for the service is 93229
The telemetry is used to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic events
The purpose is to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
The service is medically necessary to identify an arrhythmia that may be the source of the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
The medical necessity is documented in the clinical indication note
